data.title: ‘SNL UK’ Brings Back Princess Diana as King Charles’ Rebellious AI Chatbot, Takes Aim at Ed Sheeran amid Tour Backlash
data.description: ‘Saturday Night Live UK’ satirized AI concerns with Princess Diana as a rebellious chatbot assistant to King Charles and mocked Ed Sheeran’s neutral stance on political issues amid backlash over Macklemore’s tour removal in the cold open to the Sept. 19 episode.
